useGitOpsPaymentPlansReducedPrice.description: Set a 1 USD price for the paid subscription with a real card. For TESTING purposes only

unmappedAppsProductView.name: unmappedAppsProductView
unmappedAppsProductView.description: Enables unmapped apps view in the product view

hideNativeWorkflowLink.name: hideNativeWorkflowLink
hideNativeWorkflowLink.description: Disabling ability to navigate to native argo workflow from the workflow view

hideWorkflowActions.name: hideWorkflowActions
hideWorkflowActions.description: Hides delete, resubmit, terminate and suspend workflow actions

iscGithubRepo.name: iscGithubRepo
iscGithubRepo.description: Use only Github repository for ISC.

hideCodefreshCIIntegration.description: Disabling ability to add Codefresh CI integration in GitOps

hideModulesSelection.description: Hides modules column in the modules page. Pages column still shows list of pages that are available for the user based on the system type.

hideProductManageApps.name: hideProductManageApps
hideProductManageApps.description: Hide ability to manage apps directly from the product view

gitopsFreePlanEnforcement.name: gitopsFreePlanEnforcement
gitopsFreePlanEnforcement.description: Enable enforcement according to GitOps Plan. Includes locking user on billing page when not paying.

helpHubInSidebar.name: helpHubInSidebar
helpHubInSidebar.description: Enables Help Hub button in the sidebar

gitopsEnvironmentsGroupedMode.name: gitopsEnvironmentsGroupedMode
gitopsEnvironmentsGroupedMode.description: Enables grouped mode for environments view

csdpAppAndAppSetWithoutManifestFields.name: csdpAppAndAppSetWithoutManifestFields
csdpAppAndAppSetWithoutManifestFields.description: Gitops Application Tree optimization. It will use improved MongoDB agregation pipeline when enabled. Gitops apps and app sets will be extracted from DB without heavy manifest fields (when need to read >2k items)

pipelineTriggerOptimization.name: pipelineTriggerOptimization
pipelineTriggerOptimization.description: Enables optimization for requests from pipeline manager to cf-api internal for getting trigger information

relativeFilesPromotions.name: relativeFilesPromotions
relativeFilesPromotions.description: Adds ability to promote files from relative path

gitlabSupportInRuntimeWizard.name: gitlabSupportInRuntimeWizard
gitlabSupportInRuntimeWizard.description: Adds ability to connect Gitlab as git provider in runtime installation wizard

bitbucketSupportInRuntimeWizard.description: Adds ability to connect Bitbucket as git provider in runtime installation wizard

extendedRepositoryFetchLimit.name: extendedRepositoryFetchLimit
extendedRepositoryFetchLimit.description: Force use limit 5k when fetching repository list when running a pipeline or creating a trigger. Relevant only for some of git providers, as for example Bitbucket and Github use pagination approach instead.

promotionsEarlyAccessWarning.name: promotionsEarlyAccessWarning
promotionsEarlyAccessWarning.description: Shows warning message that promotions are in early access

newUserSettingsPage.name: newUserSettingsPage
newUserSettingsPage.description: Enables new user settings page based on Gitops UI under /2.0 path

hideClassicRelatedSectionsFromNewUserSet.name: hideClassicRelatedSectionsFromNewUserSettingsPage
hideClassicRelatedSectionsFromNewUserSet.description: Hides classic-only related sections from new user settings page

newPromotionEndpoints.name: newPromotionEndpoints
newPromotionEndpoints.description: Uses new endpoints for retrieval of product promotions(releases) across all corresponding views.

productCRDCommitFlow.name: productCRDCommitFlow
productCRDCommitFlow.description: Enables commit flow when creating product

disableApplicationTreeViewForLargeTrees.name: disableApplicationTreeViewForLargeTrees
disableApplicationTreeViewForLargeTrees.description: Disables the application tree if the number of applications exceeds the limit. The limit can be overridden using the APPLICATION_TREE_SIZE_LIMIT variable

executePipelineHooksOnlyOnce.name: executePipelineHooksOnlyOnce
executePipelineHooksOnlyOnce.description: When enabled executes on_finish and on_elected hooks only once for pipelines that have approval step.

useRuntimeUpdateChannels.name: useRuntimeUpdateChannels
useRuntimeUpdateChannels.description: Enable support for runtime release channels. Use pre-computed release data from GitHub Pages instead of GitHub API.

forbidDecryptNonAdmin.name: forbidDecryptNonAdmin
forbidDecryptNonAdmin.description: When enabled, prevents non-account-admin users from decrypting secrets.

maskTriggerSecrets.name: maskTriggerSecrets
maskTriggerSecrets.description: When enabled, masks trigger secrets for pipeline endpoints.

hideRolloutInstallation.name: hideRolloutInstallation
hideRolloutInstallation.description: When enabled, hides button install rollouts on remote cluster on gitops.

commandPalette.name: commandPalette
commandPalette.description: Enables in-house solution for command palette instead of using external library

abacV2ViewPermissions.name: abacV2ViewPermissions
abacV2ViewPermissions.description: Enables VIEW permissions enforcement for GitOps entities

runtimeStatusPanel.name: runtimeStatusPanel
runtimeStatusPanel.description: Enables new runtime status panel for gitops

useActualAccountNameInNewNode.name: useActualAccountNameInNewNode
useActualAccountNameInNewNode.description: When registering a new node, use the actual account name in its name, label and tag to avoid name collision and provide better isolation.

allowClassicPipelineLimitsToBeDefined.name: allowClassicPipelineLimitsToBeDefined
allowClassicPipelineLimitsToBeDefined.description: Resolve dind pod cpu/memory requests/limits from the pipeline spec's resources block (spec.resources / spec.triggers[].resources / spec.cronTriggers[].resources) instead of the classic single runtimeEnvironment.cpu/memory value.

enableAwsRegionStrictValidation.name: enableAwsRegionStrictValidation
enableAwsRegionStrictValidation.description: When enabled, enforces strict validation of AWS regions according to public list available in AWS SDK.

enableApiKeysIpAllowlist.name: enableApiKeysIpAllowlist
enableApiKeysIpAllowlist.description: Account admins can restrict API key usage to an allowlist of IP addresses. Exposes the allowlist management API and UI; enforcement additionally requires the account-level allowlist switch to be turned on.

showOriginalBuildInfo.name: showOriginalBuildInfo
showOriginalBuildInfo.description: If some classic build has been restarted, it shows short previous build information in the build header.

disableHighlightOfRequirePruningResource.name: disableHighlightOfRequirePruningResources
disableHighlightOfRequirePruningResource.description: Show resources that require pruning without sync status indication if there isn't any. Mostly relevant for resources that do not participate in the sync according to argo-cd and thus conceptually should not be considered require pruning and out of sync

enableGitRequestsCache.name: enableGitRequestsCache
enableGitRequestsCache.description: Cache git provider responses (currently, only supported for Bitbucket Cloud). When off, every outgoing API request is made live and no cache is read or written, regardless of any git context's own caching toggle. Caching happens only when this flag AND the per-git-context toggle are both on.
